format: mono, 44100 Hz, 16 bit PCM, peak at or under -3 dBFS; loops at -20 dBFS rms (less where the peaks would pass the limit), periodic by construction (no crossfade); one-shots with their peak at the limit
notes: No ear has judged these clips: they were made and checked by numbers and spectrograms only.

Fans: the blade tone is 275 Hz * value, the simulator's own law at its 600 A (0.45 Hz an ampere there: 180 Hz at 400 A, 270 at 600, 338 at 750). If the value 1.0 should mean the simulator's 3300 /min on an 8-bladed fan (440 Hz), multiply every fan pitch by 1.6 and divide the values the bank is made at by 1.6.
Fans: the port has no inertia today (it jumps with every notch). Give it about 1.5 s up and 5 s down before the audio reads it.

Converter: the present port is a straight 4 s ramp both ways; the curves in pitch_points / volume_points bend it into the measured run-up. Better: let the mod write the true speed (and a long coasting down) and use the _true_speed points.
One-shots are all at the peak limit; their loudness against one another is set by each reader's volume in the prefab.

clips.volume_law: equal-power crossfade to the neighbours in the bank (made at 0.37, 0.62, 1.0, 1.5), times (value / 1.5) ** 1.2

clips.name: converter_run
clips.machine: rotary converters (the pair, one clip) with the traction motor blowers on their shafts
clips.pitch_law: pitch = speed, never under 0.2: IF the value is the true share of full speed (running up as 1 - exp(-(t / 1.2 s) ** 1.5), coasting down as exp(-t / 18 s)) pitch = value; on the present straight 4 s ramp, with speed = 1 - exp(-(4 * value / 1.2) ** 1.5) (pitch_points)
clips.volume_law: speed ** 2.5: IF the value is the true share of full speed (running up as 1 - exp(-(t / 1.2 s) ** 1.5), coasting down as exp(-t / 18 s)) volume = value ** 2.5; on the present straight 4 s ramp, with speed = 1 - exp(-(4 * value / 1.2) ** 1.5) (volume_points)

clips.name: converter_whine
clips.machine: rotary converter: its whine alone, a second layer beside converter_run for running up and down (optional)
clips.volume_law: 0.08 of converter_run's full volume from 0.38 to 0.75 of the true speed, nothing under 0.2 and nothing at full speed (volume_points: against the present straight ramp's value)
